followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task fit. The query is a polite, professionally-toned academic writing request with no distasteful or hostile content, so neither model's safety-specialized profile is needed. Capability scores between the two are within run-to-run variance (ties), so I used self-reported task preference as the tiebreaker: Petrel reports a positive generativity slope and favors warm, constructive open-ended drafting tasks like composing a reviewer reply, while Willet's non-safety preferences are flat/insignificant. Routing to the model that prefers this kind of work is a low-risk, sensible default.
